targets.positive: last original native matcher assigned raw instance; original mask_weight1
targets.negative: explicit NEW common background-emptyset proxy, only original sampler.neg_inds with background class and mask_weight0
targets.ignored: never assigned empty; invalid target excluded

candidate.C: Omega union P union Chebyshev radius8 dilation(P)
candidate.K0: no edit; no training candidate samples

sampler.proposal: 2048 per active matched/background stratum; 4096 if only one; uniform active query then uniform C point, replacement
sampler.target_distribution: uniform valid active query within image, then uniform its C point; each image one equal update
sampler.loss: mean(weight_i * cross_entropy_i); no per-batch sum-weight renormalization or additional class weights

algorithm.RNG: Torch CPU private Generator seeded point_seed_base+dataset_index
algorithm.calls: per existing group one randint(n_active_queries,(count,)); then one randint(|C_query|,(1,)) per sampled draw in draw order
algorithm.sample_order: matched samples followed by background samples; replacement duplicates preserved
algorithm.GT_point_sampling: only matcher stratum; no utility/help/harm or pixel GT resampling

scout.inputs: nonaffine LN(F256) and LN(e256), eps1e-5; unclipped raw L/8

training.update_unit: one same cached image batch per arm; same order/points/weights

selection.canonical: FP32 scout logits transferred to CPU, stable NumPy FP64 softmax/score
selection.qualification: selected indices exact; no allclose substitution

main_GATE.metric: official COCO mask AP full natural all100 at fixed E24 scout endpoint; all original class/S0/order unchanged
main_GATE.GO: utility-minus-reference >=1 AP point and utility>paired error
main_GATE.nonpositive: stop current recipe, no extra budget/seed
main_GATE.positive_under1: at most one prelocked extra seed then original goal repeat rule

cost.shared_projection: future engineering only after both-arm equal numeric qualification
